title: Ticket Schema - ticket-000-ticket-system
description: Machine-readable validation rules from ticket-000-ticket-system.md for the ticket system.

ticket_number.description: Sequential ticket number matching # Ticket NNN heading

title.description: Lowercase kebab-case title derived from description in heading

heading.description: Full first-line heading must match '# Ticket NNN — description'

filename.description: Filename must be ticket-NNN-title.md with leading zeros and kebab-case

objective.description: One or more objective lines in present/future tense. No bullets.

items.description: At least one 'Do not' or 'Do NOT' constraint line

scope_boundaries.description: Scope and Boundaries section with at least one 'Do not' constraint

items.description: Each step must reference a specific file or command

expected_output_contains.description: Expected output patterns to grep for

files.description: Files table: all referenced paths must be listed, and vice versa

dependencies.description: List of dependencies (other tickets or external tools)

prev_number.description: Previous ticket number for continuity check

sections_order.description: Required section order: objective < scope < steps < verification < files < dependencies

unresolved_todos.description: No unresolved TODO/FIXME entries allowed — must be exactly 0
